sources.title: Stochastic Event-Triggered Sensor Schedule for Remote State Estimation
sources.author: Duo Han等
sources.claim: 硬事件选择不自动保持条件Gaussian；特定指数随机触发使条件Gaussian闭合，Theorem1的精确MMSE不可直接赋给本稿确定阈值门控。

sources.title: A Periodic Dynamic Encoding Mechanism for Stealthy Attack Detection in Distributed State Estimation
sources.author: Kun Ding; Wen Yang; Yun Liu; Yue Luo; Jialing Chen
sources.journal: International Journal of Robust and Nonlinear Control
sources.claim: 式38已由报警指示量切换局部/分布式增益，Algorithm2明确检测后重算K；编码为准备期历史加性重用，攻击和估计共享不同于本稿；不把渐近检测移为有限概率。

sources.title: Event-Triggered Distributed State Estimation for Cyber-Physical Systems Under DoS Attacks
sources.author: Yan Liu; Guang-Hong Yang
sources.claim: DoS/事件传输、局部观测器及预测数据已存在；Assumption2通过ACK/测试信号知道通道是否DoS，不能当本稿FDI检测真标签；本轮未新审其全部主定理。

sources.title: Double-Layer Detection-Based Distributed Secure State Estimation Under False Data Injection Attacks
sources.author: Minggao Zhu; Dajun Du; Xue Li; Minrui Fei; Lei Wu
sources.claim: 双层检测/预测替换与重设计增益已有；Theorem2依赖收缩/有界性，保留非零最终界，不是原共G的危险前安全或回滚。

sources.title: Consensus-based distributed estimator of cyber–physical systems against false data injection attacks: A two-layer estimation approach
sources.author: Zhichen Han; Shengbing Zhang; Zengwang Jin; Zhen Wang
sources.claim: 检测后预测替换与按(1-theta)选择剩余信息的名义增益已存在；本稿单剩余邻居的B2拒包模式可由标准信息融合直接得到；不据检测未报警认攻击为0。
